t: AI Collaboration in Action: Implementing HTMX Widgets for Pipulate Workflows
s: This article details the AI-assisted development of interactive web UI widgets for Pipulate workflows, leveraging HTMX for dynamic frontends and AI (Gemini/Claude) for code generation and architectural planning. It focuses on creating non-interactive visualization widgets and outlines a strategy for integrating various JavaScript libraries and handling dynamic content injection.
sub: Pipulate workflow widget development with AI assistance
Implementing dynamic HTMX widgets for Pipulate
AI-assisted prompt engineering for code generation
Strategy for integrating diverse JavaScript visualization libraries
Handling JavaScript execution in dynamically injected HTML
